 Order

This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicants/accused persons under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as they are under apprehension of their arrest, in connection with Crime No.49/2023, registered at Police Station Chandiya, District Umaria (M.P.)
for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B and 34 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicants submitted that applicants have not moved any application.
It is submitted that applicants are innocent and have falsely been implicated in the case.
In these circumstances, applicants be released on anticipatory bail.
3 . Learned Govt. Advocate opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.
It is submitted that applicants are the person who are beneficiary and land has been entered in their name.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of offence, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE mms Gendlal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84227341/
